name: Frightful Figment

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You can cast Figment as an occult innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. When you cast or sustain figment this way, you can attempt to demoralize with it, instead of Creating a Diversion, and the +2 circumstance bonus applies to your Intimidation check instead of Deception.
